tweaks.name: Ultimate Performance power plan (desktops)
tweaks.description: Activates Microsoft's Ultimate Performance plan, which keeps the CPU and devices out of deep power-saving states. On current CPUs the gaming benefit over Balanced is usually marginal, while idle power and heat go up noticeably, so it is opt-in. The new plan starts from Microsoft's template, so your display-off and sleep timeouts are reset to its values. Skipped on laptops, on dual-CCD Ryzen X3D CPUs (7900X3D/7950X3D/9900X3D/9950X3D, whose V-Cache scheduling needs the Balanced plan) and on PCs that cannot create the plan (e.g. Modern Standby); revert re-activates your previous plan.

tweaks.name: Hibernation and Fast Startup off (desktops)
tweaks.description: Deletes hiberfil.sys (frees several GB) and turns off Fast Startup and hybrid sleep, so every shutdown is a clean full shutdown and the Windows drive is never left locked, which is safer for dual-boot. Normal sleep keeps working; skipped on laptops, where hibernation protects the battery during long sleep.

tweaks.name: Power Throttling off (desktops)
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from throttling background apps (and pushing them onto efficiency cores on hybrid Intel CPUs), so OBS, Discord or voice chat keep full speed while a game has focus. Skipped on laptops because throttling background apps saves battery.

tweaks.name: No delay for startup apps
tweaks.description: Removes the roughly 10-second delay Windows adds before starting your startup apps after sign-in, so Steam, Discord or fan/RGB tools start right away. On an old hard drive the first seconds after sign-in can feel busier.

tweaks.name: USB selective suspend off (active plan)
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from powering down idle USB devices while on AC power in the currently active power plan, which can fix mice, headsets or controllers that drop out or wake up slowly. Slightly higher power use; a plan you switch to later is not changed.

tweaks.name: Lean visual effects
tweaks.description: Turns off window, menu and taskbar animations, window shadows, translucent selection and Aero Peek for a snappier desktop, while keeping ClearType font smoothing, thumbnails and window contents while dragging. It does not raise in-game FPS on a modern GPU; takes effect after sign-in.

tweaks.name: Faster menus (100 ms)
tweaks.description: Opens cascading menus after 100 ms instead of the default 400 ms. Purely a desktop responsiveness tweak; takes effect after sign-in.

tweaks.name: CPU core parking off (active plan)
tweaks.description: Sets 'core parking minimum cores' to 100% on AC power in the active plan so no cores are parked, which can smooth frame times in some CPU-bound games when you use the Balanced plan (Ultimate and High performance already do this). Downside: higher idle power and temperatures; skipped on dual-CCD Ryzen X3D CPUs, whose V-Cache scheduling works by parking cores.

tweaks.name: Memory compression off
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from compressing rarely used memory pages, saving a little CPU time on PCs with 32 GB or more. Downside: on 8-16 GB PCs Windows pages to disk sooner, which usually means more stutter, not less; needs the SysMain service to be enabled to change.
